title: docs: close input files in multi-HDF example
reason: Example script closes HDF5 inputs with ExitStack; example code only.

reason: Benchmark dataset prep reuses cached airline arrays; tooling only, arrays bit-identical.

title: cuda: BitonicArgSortGlobal synchronizes once, not after every pass
reason: BitonicArgSortGlobal (L1/quantile BoostFromScore percentile) syncs once after all same-stream passes instead of per pass; percentile values and model md5 identical. Perf only.

reason: CUDA launch block counts computed in 64 bits (overflowed to a negative count / failed launch for row counts within a block of INT32_MAX); L1/quantile buffer Init deduplicated. Models md5-identical otherwise.

title: python: reject unidentified CatBoost objectives
reason: CatBoost importer (in 1.1.0) treated missing/empty loss_function metadata as RMSE regression; now raises the unsupported-loss ValueError. Models with a named loss convert as before.

title: treelearner: size linear matrices from actual leaf features
reason: Linear-tree normal-equation matrices sized per leaf from its actual feature count instead of the maximum; same accumulation/solve order, predictions SHA-identical. Memory/perf only.

title: capi: CSC_RowIterator::Get answers rows in any order
reason: CSC_RowIterator::Get rescans for out-of-order rows (returned 0 before); all in-tree CSC callers read rows ascending per thread, which takes the same path. Predictions identical; perf from inlining.

title: python: bound binary category metadata reads
reason: Python reads the FALB section table to seek straight to the pandas-category trailer instead of doubling tail reads; same categories found (round-trip tested), perf only.

title: boosting: release binary sections after container copy
reason: SaveModelToBinary frees each section payload after copying it into the container; byte-identical output, memory only.

title: application: Predictor falls back to a temporary buffer past its per-thread buffers
reason: Predictor's per-thread buffers (sized by OMP_NUM_THREADS) were indexed by omp_get_thread_num; single-row fast predict from a wider caller parallel region read past them (SEGV). Predictions unchanged.

title: boosting: reuse prediction conversion buffers per worker
reason: GBDT::GetPredictAt reuses per-worker firstprivate conversion buffers instead of per-row vectors; every element rewritten per row, outputs SHA-identical. Perf only.

title: metric: reuse multiclass evaluation buffers per worker
reason: MulticlassMetric::Eval reuses per-worker firstprivate buffers; buffers fully rewritten per row, same reduction, result bits identical. Perf only.

title: utils: ArgMaxAtK selects with std::nth_element instead of a last-element-pivot quickselect
reason: ArgMaxAtK uses std::nth_element (was quadratic on sorted input); same k-th value and partition guarantee, callers (L1/quantile percentile, GOSS threshold, voting MaxK with feature tie-break) read values only. md5 identical.

title: python: report unexpected FIL fallback causes
reason: FIL conversion/prediction fallbacks now log the swallowed exception; fallback behaviour (CPU predictor) unchanged. Logging only.

title: cuda: rank_xendcg draws its per-item uniforms on the device
reason: CUDA rank_xendcg generates per-item uniforms on device via LCG jump-ahead from the same per-query seeds; draw-for-draw identical to the CPU generator (tested), model md5 identical. Perf only.

title: objective: inline the default binary gradient label rule
reason: BinaryLogloss::GetGradients uses a direct label>0 test when the predicate is the default rule; same predicate, gradient/hessian hash identical. Perf only.

title: tests: isolate cached synthetic regression arrays
reason: Test utility returns copies of cached synthetic arrays; tests only.

title: utils: TextReader::ReadContent reads straight into the result
reason: TextReader::ReadContent (model-file load) reads chunks directly into the result instead of via a staging buffer; same bytes returned (tested). Perf only.

title: chore: select benchmark GPU memory telemetry explicitly
reason: Benchmark GPU memory telemetry queries the selected GPU; tooling only.

title: objective: reduce per-query ranking scratch allocations
reason: Ranking objectives reserve adjusted-score vectors and reuse thread_local XE rho/params buffers that are fully overwritten before reading; gradient hashes identical. Perf only.

title: io: read a binary dataset's raw values a block of rows at a time
reason: Binary-dataset raw values (linear_tree) read in 16 MiB row blocks instead of per row; same scatter into raw_data_, model md5 identical. Perf only.

title: treelearner: parallelize large linear leaf-map clearing
reason: Linear-tree GetLeafMap clears the leaf map in parallel above 65,536 rows; same values, leaf-map hashes identical. Perf only.

title: cuda: fill the dense binner's category table in parallel
reason: GPU dense binner fills large category-id tables in parallel; each slot gets the same read-only ValueToBin value, model md5 identical. Perf only.

title: tests: select GPU guard telemetry device explicitly
reason: GPU guard gate script selects the GPU explicitly for telemetry; test tooling only.

title: treelearner: flatten linear prediction metadata
reason: Linear-tree training score update flattens per-leaf coefficient/feature arrays; same feature and arithmetic order, output hashes identical. Perf only.

title: cuda: drop redundant device syncs from the per-split partition and readback
reason: CUDA classic per-split flow drops device syncs that stream ordering already covers (SplitInnerKernel moved to the same stream); model md5 identical for linear/monotone/interaction cases. Perf only.

title: chore: avoid device staging for benchmark CPU fallback
reason: Benchmark prediction skips device staging when FIL is unavailable; tooling only, outputs bit-identical.

title: application: allocate a Predictor thread's dense buffer on its first dense row
reason: Predictor allocates each thread's zeroed dense buffer lazily on its first dense row; same zero-initialized buffer, predictions identical. Memory/perf only.

title: tests: bound lattice worker execution and stop on timeout
reason: Lattice gate workers get a deadline and timeout exit status; test tooling only.

title: cuda: size the per-leaf histogram slab in 64 bits
reason: CUDA per-leaf histogram slab size computed in 64 bits; in 1.1.0 num_total_bin*2*num_leaves wrapped int (past 2^31) and kernels wrote past a too-small buffer (memory corruption/illegal access). Normal sizes md5-identical.

title: capi: CSC prediction threads build their column iterators on their first row
reason: CSC prediction threads build their column iterators lazily on their first row instead of serially up front; same iterators and ascending access, predictions identical. Perf only.

title: docs: clarify performance plot run aggregation
reason: Comment fix in perf-plot generator; docs only.

title: python: restore model conversion summaries
reason: `python -m falcata convert` prints its size/ratio summary and capability-loss notices again; CLI messages only, conversion unchanged.

title: cuda: the auto device choice checks the GPU gpu_device_id names
reason: Auto device choice (device_type unset, in 1.1.0) now probes the gpu_device_id GPU, not device 0: a missing/unusable named GPU falls back to CPU (was a crash); usable named GPU with unusable device 0 now trains on CUDA, not CPU.

title: tests: retain crashes found during fuzz timeout isolation
reason: FALB fuzz gate keeps crashing reproducers found during timeout isolation; fuzz tooling only.

title: boosting: quantized training refuses negative hessians from a custom objective
reason: Quantized training packs hessians into unsigned fields; 1.1.0 trained silently corrupted trees on negative custom hessians. GBDT::TrainOneIter now Fatal when a custom objective returns any negative hessian under quantization.

title: io: a Booster refuses to train on a Dataset that gained features; keep replaced CUDA columns alive
reason: Training a Booster after add_features_from on its training Dataset read stale-sized learner arrays (CPU segfault/heap overflow) or freed CUDA columns; now a clean 'gained features' error, old columns retired not freed.

title: tests: describe the actual small median leaf fixture
reason: Test docstring/comment correction only.

title: network: initialize every Linkers member, including in the placeholder
reason: Default member initializers for the no-network Linkers placeholder (rank 0, one machine); latent indeterminate values, no stated model or prediction effect.

title: c_api: a booster reset keeps its resolved quant_mode (CUDA custom-objective crash)
reason: Booster::ResetConfig now carries the resolved quant_mode; a reset re-mapped deterministic=true + quant_mode=none to fixedpoint and the CUDA learner (no discretizer) segfaulted; same in 1.1.0.

title: network: TcpSocket owns its descriptor (move-only, closed by the destructor)
reason: TcpSocket becomes move-only and closes its descriptor in the destructor (fd leak on failed setup); two-rank models md5-identical.

title: cuda: ShufflePrefixSumExclusive orders the base reads before the hand-off writes
reason: Adds barriers in ShufflePrefixSumExclusive (1.1.0 race: warp read its base while the previous warp overwrote it, FP values can differ in last bits); md5 identical in tested runs.

title: tests: bound and supervise perf remeasurement workers
reason: Perf-gate test harness: deadline and supervised cleanup for remeasurement workers; tests only.

title: boosting: scope score transfers across metric evaluation
reason: Reuses one host/device score transfer for all metrics of an evaluation pass; result bits stated identical.

title: network: a peer that fails or goes away is an error, not an abort or a hang
reason: Socket transport: a failed/closed peer or bad handshake now raises an error instead of std::terminate or an infinite recv loop; two-rank models md5-identical.

title: network: list every IPv4 address of each Windows adapter, not only the first
reason: Windows GetLocalIpList walks every address of each adapter; a machine listed by a secondary address failed setup with 'Machine list file doesn't contain the local machine'.

title: network: run SendRecv's sending half on one long-lived thread
reason: SendRecv's threaded send runs on one long-lived worker thread instead of a new std::thread per exchange; perf only, per-rank models md5-identical.

title: network: check the MPI thread level; keep int64 SendRecv on one thread under MPI
reason: MPI Linkers now reads the granted thread level and Fatals below MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED (1.1.0 ignored it); int64 SendRecv under MPI no longer sends from a second thread (that segfaulted).

title: capi: overlap the device-to-host copies of the device-matrix fallback with the host push
reason: Device-matrix host-fallback dataset build overlaps pinned async D2H copies with the host push; saved binary Dataset byte-identical.

title: cuda: CUDARoundInt rounds negative values like the CPU RoundInt (#322)
reason: CUDARoundInt (1.1.0 code) now rounds negatives half away from zero and NaN to 0, like CPU RoundInt (#322); changes count estimates only for negative hessian sums.

title: python: predict from a file into memory instead of through a result text file
reason: Python predict(file path) now reads predictions in memory instead of np.loadtxt of a text file; values byte-identical, but a one-row file now returns shape (1, k) instead of (k,) / (k, 1).

title: tests: retry distributed workers with fresh ports when a port is taken before they bind
reason: Distributed test harness retries workers with fresh ports and no longer hangs on a port collision; tests only.

title: tests: attribute GPU memory by the host PID inside a PID namespace
reason: GPU memory tests find the host PID inside a PID namespace; tests only.

title: R-package: bound-check native buffer and sparse count arguments
reason: R .Call wrappers bound-check GetEval buffer, CSC count arguments and single-row lengths; buffer overrun / wrapped NA counts now a clean R error.

title: R-package: dump the model in one call for dumps up to 64 MiB
reason: R dump_model starts with a 64 MiB uninitialized buffer to avoid a second serialization; dumps byte-identical.

title: docs: skip the R documentation rebuild when its sources are unchanged
reason: Docs build skips the R docs rebuild when a source fingerprint matches; docs tooling only.

title: tests: run the SWIG StringArray capacity regression as a registered gtest
reason: Moves the SWIG StringArray capacity regression into a registered gtest; tests only.

title: tests: fix the pre-commit hits from today's merges
reason: Import-order and typo fixes in test files for pre-commit; tests only.

title: treelearner: leaves without linear features keep the constant fallback when data has NaN
reason: Linear trees with NaN: leaves without linear features keep the constant fallback again; fixes a regression from #204 (complete-row count), restoring 1.1.0 behaviour for those leaves.

title: tests: explicit doubles in test_fast_handle_validation.R (R lint)
reason: R lint fix (explicit doubles) in a test file.

title: metric: warn when CUDA multi_rmse falls back to CPU
reason: Adds the CPU-fallback warning for CUDA multi_rmse/multi_regression metric; logging only.

title: NCCLGBDT: gather the training scores once per metric pass
reason: NCCL multi-GPU EvalOneMetric gathers training scores once per metric pass; perf only, same scores evaluated (multi-GPU runtime untested by author).

title: cuda: check every device past 62 for build support, not only the first
reason: Per-device build-support check claimed one shared bit for all device ids >= 63, so an unsupported GPU past index 62 skipped the probe and failed at its first kernel; now each id is checked.

title: CUDA: score linear trees on the device for validation sets
reason: Linear trees on CUDA: validation/OOB/DART rescoring now runs on the device with non-contracted mul/add matching the host evaluator; model md5 and validation predictions identical in 7 cases.

title: cuda: class-major multiclass softmax scratch (coalesced)
reason: CUDA multiclass softmax scratch becomes class-major (coalesced); same operations and order, gradient/hessian hash identical.

title: tests: CUDA regression tests for three fixed findings
reason: Adds CUDA regression gtests for three earlier fixes (ReduceMinGlobal, weighted binary init score, row-data partitions); tests only.

title: cuda: check the gradient interleave launch and the L2 window attribute
reason: Checks the gradient-interleave launch and cudaStreamSetAttribute; a zero-row launch left a pending CUDA error that a later unrelated check turned into a Fatal. 1.1.0 code.

title: tests: pin the balanced bagging reset regression test to the CPU device
reason: Pins a balanced-bagging reset test to the CPU device; tests only.

title: tests: size the subset one-copy device memory test above the nvidia-smi granularity
reason: Resizes a device-memory test above nvidia-smi's 2 MiB granularity; tests only.

title: tests: drop the needless len captures in test_linkers_sendrecv (clang -Werror)
reason: constexpr instead of lambda captures in a socket test to build under clang -Werror; tests only.

title: utils: ReadContent grows its buffer once per chunk, the same on every library
reason: TextReader::ReadContent reserves once per chunk so capacity growth is the same on MSVC and libstdc++; same content read.

title: io: Dataset constructors initialise every scalar member
reason: Default member initializers for Dataset scalars; loaders already assign them, only a bare-constructed Dataset (tests) read garbage.

title: tests: CUDA rank_xendcg writes stay inside each query's rows
reason: Adds a CUDA rank_xendcg query-bounds regression gtest; tests only.

title: tests: make the ranking scratch and voting top_k tests clean under TASK=cuda
reason: Makes ranking-scratch and voting top_k tests deterministic or skipped under TASK=cuda; tests only.

title: cuda: refit the linear leaf models of a linear-tree refit
reason: CUDA FitByExistingTree refit only leaf outputs, never the linear leaf models (1.1.0 code); refit now refits constants/coefficients like the CPU LinearTreeLearner.

title: cuda: keep the constant fallback of a linear leaf without features when a split has NaN
reason: CUDA CalculateLinearCUDA counted every row of a featureless (categorical-only path) leaf when a split feature has NaN and fitted its own constant (1.1.0 did too); now keeps the leaf output like CPU.

title: python: pickle linear-tree boosters with the text payload
reason: Pickling (default FALB format) a linear_tree Booster or sklearn estimator raised 'FALB v1 cannot store linear trees'; linear models now pickle with the text payload.

title: model io: FALB/pickle fail to load feature names containing '='
reason: Model loader stops the header scan at 'end of trees'; FALB/pickle loads (and zero-tree text models) with a feature name containing '=' raised 'Wrong line at model file'.

title: model io: dump_model emits invalid JSON for feature names with tabs or backslashes
reason: dump_model JSON-escapes feature names; names with tabs/control chars made dump_model raise, and backslashes could decode to a different name. Dump output only, models unchanged.

title: treelearner: forced splits: unused/unsplittable features, num_leaves, file validation, reset safety, col/row parity
reason: CPU forced splits (1.1.0 code): forced features kept in row-wise bin under feature_fraction, histograms built if parent unsplittable, refused leaves stop forcing; plus crash fixes, file validation.

title: python: ObliquePool.fit on a CuPy matrix raised AttributeError (cupy has no nanpercentile)
reason: ObliquePool.fit on a CuPy matrix raised AttributeError (cupy has no nanpercentile); robust stats now computed on the host. 1.1.0 code.

title: io: give Tree's scalar members default values (a loaded tree left them indeterminate)
reason: Default member initializers for Tree scalars; a text-loaded tree's indeterminate track_branch_features_ was UB on copy, but is only read by Split, so behaviour unchanged.

title: model io: bad_alloc while saving a model aborts the process
reason: SaveModelToString's parallel loop now has OMP exception guards; bad_alloc while saving aborted the process with std::terminate, now a FalcataError.

title: treelearner: refit with path_smooth smooths toward the parent node's output (was a segfault)
reason: CPU refit with path_smooth > 0 smoothed each leaf toward its parent node index (and never leaf 0), or segfaulted on loaded trees; it now smooths toward the parent node output.

title: linear trees: rf + linear_tree segfaults when a class gets a constant tree
reason: LinearTreeLearner scores and refits non-linear (constant) trees through the base learner; rf + linear_tree segfaulted when a class got a constant tree.

title: boosting: RF trees without a split carry the class constant every round (absent-class drift, linear segfault)
reason: RF (1.1.0 code): untrained class's constant now in every round (was round 1 only, predictions drifted to 0); 1-leaf trees get bias and are scored; empty bag guarded; linear segfault fixed.

title: importers: from_xgboost mispredicts when the logistic base_score is 0 or 1
reason: from_xgboost logistic base_score: now clamped like the writing XGBoost version and converted with float32 -log(1/p-1); base_score 0/1 was ~14 logits off, and other values shift slightly.

title: metric: multiclass metrics reject labels outside [0, num_class) (auc_mu heap overflow)
reason: multi_logloss, multi_error and auc_mu now Fatal on labels outside [0, num_class); 1.1.0 read out of bounds (garbage metric values or crash), e.g. bad labels in a validation set.

title: treelearner: ColSampler clears its feature mask with std::fill, not memset (UBSan null pointer)
reason: memset(null,0,0) replaced by std::fill on an empty ColSampler mask; UBSan-only report, normal builds behave and predict identically before and after.

title: treelearner: a parameter reset works on a dataset without usable features
reason: HistogramPool::ResetConfig CHECK_GT(num_features,0) failed on any reset_parameter for a dataset with no usable features; now returns early (inherited, in 1.1.0).

title: io: model_to_string/save_model silently truncate the model under memory pressure
reason: stringstream bad_alloc set badbit silently so save_model/model_to_string returned truncated text under memory pressure; badbit now throws. Valid saves unchanged.

title: python: trees_to_dataframe handles a 1-leaf linear tree (KeyError: 'leaf_weight')
reason: trees_to_dataframe raised KeyError 'leaf_weight' on a 1-leaf linear tree; single-node test fixed. Output for other models unchanged.

title: boosting: the bagging subset holds at least one row (tiny bagging_fraction CHECK failure)
reason: bagging subset Dataset(bag_data_cnt_) CHECK-failed when bagging_fraction*num_data rounds to 0; clamped to >=1 row, only affects the previously failing case.

title: io: convert_model if-else code ignored the threshold on Zero/NaN missing-type splits
reason: convert_model if-else export dropped the threshold on Zero/NaN missing-type numerical splits (code from 1.1.0/LightGBM); generated code now matches native prediction, inf thresholds compile.

title: io: a negative LibSVM feature index overflowed the heap (segfault); reject it and out-of-range indices
reason: Negative LibSVM feature index overflowed the heap (segfault), indices >= INT_MAX overflowed Atoi; both, and indices with trailing garbage, are now rejected with a clear error.

title: io: a bad token in a .weight/.init file aborted the process (exception inside an OpenMP loop)
reason: A bad token in a .weight/.init file threw inside an OpenMP loop and called std::terminate; loops now use OMP_*_EX so the error reaches the caller.

title: importers: from_xgboost silently drops DART tree weights
reason: from_xgboost ignored DART weight_drop: XGBoost>=3.4 dart-trained models converted but mispredicted; leaves now scaled by weight_drop. Legacy 'dart' layout (refused in 1.1.0) now converts.

title: io: rebuild a sparse multi-value bin whose estimated index type is too narrow
reason: Sparse multi-val bin index type chosen from a sample estimate could be too narrow (wrap/segfault in 1.1.0, error after #341); bin is now rebuilt with exact count. Fitting bins unchanged.

title: boosting: GOSS draws one thread-independent sample when deterministic
reason: GOSS computed top_rate threshold and other_rate draw per thread block, so deterministic=true GOSS depended on num_threads; now one block when deterministic, changing the sample.

title: boosting: a failed parameter reset re-points the learner at the kept config (use-after-free)
reason: A failed reset_parameter left learner/sample strategy on a freed Config (use-after-free) and kept rejected keys in the C API config; now rolled back. GOSS keeps its subset across resets.

title: model io: malformed model files hang, crash or overflow buffers (validate loaded trees)
reason: Malformed text/FALB model files hung, segfaulted, SIGFPE'd or overflowed buffers; loaders now validate tree structure, counts, num_tree_per_iteration and objective. Valid models load as before.

title: falb: a corrupt raw_len makes the loader allocate gigabytes (OOM kill)
reason: Corrupt FALB raw_len made the loader allocate/zero gigabytes (OOM kill); raw_len now bounded by deflate's 1032:1 ratio, cat_threshold range-checked before allocation.

title: python: Booster(model_bin=b.model_to_binary()) loses pandas categories and mispredicts
reason: model_to_binary() dropped pandas_categorical and model_from_binary() set it to None (both in 1.1.0), so a bytes round trip recoded categories by the new frame; trailer now written and read.

title: falb: compress_level outside 0-9 gives a zlib error or is silently ignored
reason: SaveModelToBinary now rejects compress_level outside [0,9]; in 1.1.0 negative levels were silently written uncompressed (and >9 gave a zlib error).

title: cuda: pair-joint launch shapes also respect the device-level kernels' limits (too many resources on CUDA 13.2)
reason: PairJointDeviceLimits took register counts only from host-launched kernels; device-level instantiations (in 1.1.0) failed with 'too many resources' on CUDA 13.2. Integer histograms, md5s unchanged.

title: model io: LightGBM 3.x models with constant trees fail to load
reason: LightGBM 3.x constant trees with empty leaf_count= failed to load after #257 added the end check to CommonC::StringToArrayFast (1.1.0 had no check); empty value now read as absent.

title: objective: range-check ranking and multiclass labels before casting them to int
reason: rank_xendcg now rejects |label|>=1024 or NaN (1.1.0 trained, with UB cast / NaN gradients); lambdarank/NDCG and multiclass range-check before int cast (those already errored).

title: common: Common::Atoi overflows (UB) on long digit strings
reason: Common::Atoi now saturates instead of wrapping on out-of-range digit strings; reaches only corrupt model fields here, and the config-parameter effect is superseded by #460's rejection.

title: utils: reject int parameters outside the int range instead of overflowing
reason: AtoiAndCheck now rejects int parameters outside the int32 range; 1.1.0 wrapped them silently (UB) and trained with a garbage value.

title: cuda: categorical splits keep the leaf's monotone bounds (monotone constraints broken with categorical features)
reason: CUDA categorical split finders ignored the leaf's monotone [min,max] bounds (USE_MC only on numerical finders in 1.1.0); now clamp outputs and gain like CPU.

title: io: corrupt binary datasets / serialized references crash the loader (bounds-check them)
reason: Binary dataset loaders now bounds-check header/metadata/bins (corrupt files crashed). Side effect: with used_data_indices, multi-value groups now step by serialized, not partitioned, bin size.

title: io: labels and weights read from text files get the same NaN/inf handling as the API
reason: Text loaders set labels/weights via SetLabelAt/SetWeightAt without AvoidInf (1.1.0/LightGBM); NaN label/weight now 0 and inf clamped, as for numpy input. Also fixes an auc_mu OOB write.

title: model io: text models with CRLF line endings fail to load
reason: Text models with CRLF line endings failed to load (tree_sizes offsets off by the \r bytes); \r\n is now folded to \n before parsing. LF models take the same path.

title: cuda: score a stump without traversing it (update(train_set=...) / add_valid crashed with an illegal memory access)
reason: CUDA score update traversed stumps from node 0 (empty device arrays), so update(train_set=...)/add_valid on a model with a stump hit an illegal memory access (same in 1.1.0); stump now adds leaf value.

title: cuda: update(train_set=...) on a dataset with no usable feature segfaulted (empty feature_hist_offsets)
reason: CUDA ResetTrainingData called feature_hist_offsets().back() on an empty vector (no usable feature) and segfaulted (in 1.1.0); now guarded as in Init.

title: boosting: a DART iteration that adds no tree left its dropped trees negated in the model
reason: DART returned before Normalize when an iteration added no tree, leaving that iteration's dropped trees negated in the model (1.1.0/LightGBM code); they are now restored.

title: io: reject negative query counts; a .query file longer than the .weight file read past the weights
reason: Negative group/query counts made query boundaries go backwards (OOB, abort/segfault); a .query longer than .weight over-read before the size check rejected it. Both now rejected cleanly.

title: objective: lambdarank crashed on an empty query; its weight was 0 / 0 (NaN weighted metrics)
reason: lambdarank segfaulted on an empty query (now skipped); CalculateQueryWeights divided 0/0 for an empty query, so weighted ndcg/map were NaN in configs that trained (e.g. rank_xendcg); now weight 0.

title: cuda: split_gain / gain importance were min_gain_to_split lower than the CPU model's
reason: CUDA learner stored split gain net of min_gain_to_split (no add-back in 1.1.0), unlike CPU; offset now added back. Tree structure unchanged; split_gain in model text and gain importance change.

title: metric: weighted NDCG counted all-negative queries with weight 1 (NDCG could exceed 1)
reason: Weighted NDCG added 1.0 instead of the query weight for all-negative queries (LightGBM code, in 1.1.0), so it could exceed 1; now weighted. Training unchanged, reported metric and early stopping change.

title: model io: FALB files fail as init_model / CLI input_model / FLC_BoosterCreateFromModelfile
reason: Boosting::CreateBoosting refused FALB files ('Unknown model format'), so init_model, CLI input_model/refit and FLC_BoosterCreateFromModelfile failed on .falb; FALB magic now detected. Text path unchanged.

title: cuda: extra_trees read an uninitialized threshold on features of two bins (non-deterministic models)
reason: CUDA numerical split finders left shared rand_threshold uninitialized when num_bin==2 under extra_trees (in 1.1.0), giving non-deterministic/wrong splits; now 0 as on CPU.

title: io: saving a dataset with no usable features passed a null pointer to fwrite (UBSan)
reason: LocalFile::Write skips fwrite for a 0-byte write (null data() of an empty vector); UBSan-only, the written binary file is the same.

title: io: Dataset.add_features_from(itself) was a use-after-free; reject it
reason: Dataset.add_features_from(itself) iterated vectors it was appending to (use-after-free, segfault); now rejected with a clear error.

title: treelearner: linear leaf fit sums rows on one thread when deterministic
reason: LinearTreeLearner::CalculateLinear summed X^T H X / X^T g in per-thread buffers (1.1.0/LightGBM), so deterministic linear trees varied with num_threads; now one thread when deterministic.

title: predictor: predicting a headered text file overflowed the heap when lines and header differ in width
reason: Predicting a headered text file: data lines wider than the header read past feature_remapper and picked garbage remappings (silent misprediction, 1.1.0/LightGBM); extra fields now dropped.

title: c_api: a rejected update(train_set=...) freed the objective GBDT still used (use-after-free)
reason: A rejected update(train_set=...) had already freed the objective/metrics GBDT kept (use-after-free on next update); now build-then-commit. Also rejects resets whose trees lack bin metadata (crashed).

title: c_api: FLC_DatasetPushRows* wrote past the Dataset for an out-of-range start_row/nrow
reason: FLC_DatasetPushRows* never range-checked start_row/nrow and wrote past the bins (heap corruption); out-of-range pushes now fail cleanly. In-range pushes unchanged.

title: boosting: FLC_BoosterRefit with an out-of-range leaf prediction aborted the process (CHECK inside OpenMP)
reason: FLC_BoosterRefit CHECK on leaf index inside OpenMP called std::terminate (negatives unchecked); all indices now validated up front. Booster.refit computes in-range indices itself.

title: cuda: num_leaves=131072 failed with '[CUDA] invalid argument' (level pairs exceed gridDim.y)
reason: num_leaves=131072 failed ('invalid argument', >65535 level pairs on grid y); HybridGrowthUsable now refuses budgets >131070, so num_leaves=131071 (which trained in 1.1.0) also moves to the per-split loop.

title: io: a binary dataset file accepts categorical_feature given by column name
reason: Training from a .bin dataset with categorical_feature=name:... failed ('Could not find categorical_feature') since name lookup ran against an empty header map; now skipped for binary files.

title: c_api: an unknown predict_type silently predicted as C_API_PREDICT_NORMAL
reason: C API predictors and FLC_BoosterCalcNumPredict now reject predict_type outside 0-3; 1.1.0 silently predicted such values as C_API_PREDICT_NORMAL. Python/R/SWIG only pass 0-3.

title: gates: falb_fuzz exercises loaded models and mutates the section table
reason: Test gate only: tests/gates/falb_fuzz.py now exercises loaded models and adds section-table/payload mutations and seeds.

title: model io: convert_model silently dropped linear trees' linear models (converted code mispredicted)
reason: ModelToIfElse now refuses linear-tree models; 1.1.0 convert_model succeeded but emitted constant leaf outputs, dropping the linear models (converted code mispredicted).

title: treelearner: linear_tree on a Dataset built without it read a missing raw buffer (C API / CLI)
reason: linear_tree=true on a Dataset built without raw values (raw C API / CLI from a .bin saved without it) read an empty raw buffer and segfaulted; InitLinear now fails cleanly.

title: boosting: clear errors for RF configurations it cannot train
reason: RF's bare CHECK calls for missing sampling and init_score become Log::Fatal with clear messages; the same configurations are accepted and refused as before (error text only).

title: R tests: 9 test_lgb.Booster.R failures came from the max_delta_step=-1 default; pin 0 where tests hard-code LightGBM numbers
reason: R tests only: pin max_delta_step=0 where tests hard-code LightGBM numbers and expect the -1 default in saved params; no library change.

title: swig: a ChunkedArray error (e.g. chunk size 0) aborted the JVM; raise RuntimeException
reason: SWIG ChunkedArray errors (chunk size 0, bad allocation) crossed JNI and aborted the JVM; a scoped %exception now raises java.lang.RuntimeException.

title: treelearner: OpenCL feature upload aborted the process on Log::Fatal (exception escaped an OpenMP thread)
reason: Legacy OpenCL learner (device_type=gpu): a Log::Fatal inside the parallel Feature4 upload called std::terminate; loop now uses OMP_*_EX so the (still refused) reset raises FalcataError.

title: R: lgb.convert_with_rules() used factor codes instead of labels (silently wrong categories); logical columns failed
reason: R lgb.convert_with_rules indexed rules by factor integer code, not label (LightGBM code, in 1.1.0), giving wrong codes when levels differ; now looks up by label. Logical TRUE/FALSE columns (errored) now convert.

title: boosting: a 2-D label with a single-target objective silently trained on its first column
reason: New CheckSingleTargetLabels fails when a non-multi_regression objective gets a label count != num_data; 1.1.0 Metadata accepted any multiple and trained silently on the first column.

title: treelearner: a NaN split gain was taken as a split (invalid threshold, segfault in BinToValue)
reason: Stop checks use !(gain > 0) so a NaN-gain categorical candidate (from extreme init scores) ends the tree; in 1.1.0 it was split on with threshold 0xFFFFFFFF and segfaulted.

title: falb: split importance is all zero for models loaded without diagnostics
reason: Models loaded from FALB without diagnostics now count every split in split importance (was all zero, FALB existed in 1.1.0); re-saved models carry real split counts. Trees/predictions unchanged.

title: metric: name the metric (and quantile's alpha) when refusing bad input
reason: Replaces bare CHECK calls for gamma/gamma_deviance label <= 0 and quantile alpha outside (0,1) with named Log::Fatal messages; same inputs refused as before.

title: c_api: FLC_SampleIndices memcpy'd from null for 0 rows; FLC_GetSampleCount returned negative counts
reason: FLC_SampleIndices no longer memcpys from null for 0 rows (UBSan abort); negative num_total_row now rejected instead of returning a negative count. No model effect.

title: treelearner: linear trees treat non-finite feature values like NaN (NaN models from inf/1e300 inputs)
reason: Linear-tree fit, scoring and Tree::Predict treat +-inf and beyond-float-range values like NaN (leaf constant); 1.1.0 (isnan only) produced NaN coefficients and NaN predictions.

title: io: text data files with a UTF-8 BOM failed to load (BOM stuck to the first value / header name)
reason: TextReader/format sniffing skip a UTF-8 BOM. Headerless BOM files failed in 1.1.0 (crash part); headered BOM files trained with first feature named '\ufeffa' and name-mapped prediction treated it as missing.

title: falb: a NaN threshold changes predictions after a FALB round trip
reason: FALB ThresholdDictionary used std::less<double>, merging a NaN threshold with another value on save (FALB in 1.1.0); NaN-aware comparator keeps it. Finite models byte-identical.

title: R: predict() on zero rows failed with 'missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed'
reason: R predict() on a zero-row matrix errored ('missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed'); now returns an empty vector/matrix of the per-row width.

title: boosting: count a kept stump-only first iteration (rescoring missed trees)
reason: A kept stump-only first iteration now increments iter_; 1.1.0 left it uncounted, so rescoring (update(train_set), add_valid) missed trees, bagging schedule/DART tree weights were off by one.

title: io: precise_float_parser was silently ignored for LibSVM feature values
reason: LibSVMParser parsed feature values with fast Common::Atof regardless of precise_float_parser (1.1.0 code); now uses atof_, changing bin boundaries/thresholds and predictions by an ulp.

title: io: a LibSVM file with a single feature (index 0) failed with 'Check failed: (max_col_idx) > (0)'
reason: GetNumColFromLIBSVMFile's CHECK_GT(max_col_idx,0) rejected a zero-based LibSVM file whose only feature is index 0; now loads (clean error only if no index:value token).

title: io: a LibSVM file starting with label-only rows (no nonzero feature) failed format detection
reason: GetDataType rejected a LibSVM file whose first two rows are label-only ('Unknown format'); now scans further sampled lines for index:value. CSV/TSV detection unchanged.

title: boosting: enabling bagging over two reset_parameter calls read a freed config (use-after-free)
reason: Bagging strategy kept a freed config pointer when a reset left bagging off (1.1.0 code); a later re-enable compared against freed memory and could skip re-bagging if the stale values matched.

title: c_api: a rejected add_valid stayed registered; a later objective reset read the freed Dataset
reason: A rejected add_valid stayed in the Booster's valid lists, so a later objective reset read the freed Dataset / failed a CHECK; now registered only after GBDT accepts it.

title: treelearner: split-count estimates saturate instead of overflowing int (UBSan, extreme weights)
reason: Split-count estimates now saturate in 64-bit instead of overflowing int (UB); bit-identical unless counts overflow (368-config grid identical), which needs extreme opposite-sign weights.

title: application: task=refit with a one-column-narrower file overflowed the heap (feature count not checked)
reason: CLI task=refit now fails when the loaded Dataset's feature count differs from the model's; 1.1.0 accepted a one-column-narrower file (label read as a feature) and overread the heap on save.

title: c_api: after add_features_from on its training Dataset, a Booster's reset_parameter read freed memory (extend the guard)
reason: Extends the 'training Dataset gained features' guard (7e49bcdf/#386) to reset_parameter, refit, add_valid and ResetTrainingData; these read freed learner state after add_features_from (UAF).

title: cuda: rf on a dataset with no usable feature segfaulted (Train read device row data that was never built)
reason: CUDASingleGPUTreeLearner::Train returns a single-leaf tree when no feature is usable; CUDA boosting=rf (sequential and forest-batched) segfaulted on unbuilt device row data (code in 1.1.0).

title: treelearner: predicting between linear-tree iterations raised the thread count and overflowed per-thread buffers
reason: CalculateLinear grows per-thread XTHX/XTg buffers when a prediction raised the process thread count between linear-tree iterations (heap-buffer-overflow, code in 1.1.0).

title: treelearner: CEGB + reset_parameter(num_leaves larger) wrote past its split cache
reason: CEGB Init now grows splits_per_leaf_ after reset_parameter raises num_leaves; 1.1.0 wrote past the cache (heap-buffer-overflow). Test: same model as created with the larger num_leaves.

title: swig: StringArray read uninitialized slots and wrapped huge sizes (JVM crash / heap overflow)
reason: SWIG StringArray value-initializes slots and rejects wrapping sizes (negative Java long -> SIZE_MAX); 1.1.0 read garbage, crashed the JVM or overflowed the heap. No model effect.

title: treelearner: a NaN categorical split gain is never splittable (SEGV, exposed by #322)
reason: Categorical finder skips NaN gains and emits no split when best_threshold stays -1 (SEGV on wrapped category index); repro regressed via #322 RoundInt, NaN path older. Finite gains unchanged (grid).

title: treelearner: training after an in-place refit failed (CHECK) or overflowed the linear workspaces
reason: Training after an in-place FLC_BoosterRefit failed a data-partition CHECK (plain trees) or overflowed linear workspaces (RefitTree's InitLinear sizing is 1.2-line code); partition is now reset in BeforeTrain.

title: predictor: a FastConfig changed its iteration range after other predictions; concurrent ranges overflowed buffers
reason: Predictors keep their own iteration range instead of the booster's shared InitPredict state (1.1.0 code); FastConfig silently took the range of the last other prediction. Also fixes concurrent-range overflow.

title: cuda: device_type=cuda with no visible GPU aborted the process (CHAllocator::deallocate threw from a destructor)
reason: CHAllocator::deallocate threw from a destructor when no CUDA device is visible, terminating the process; now frees/leaks without throwing so the no-device error is catchable.

title: boosting: a reset that turns bagging off kept training on the last bag (and subset/index switches overflow)
reason: A reset turning bagging off now hands the learner all rows; 1.1.0 (inherited) kept growing every later tree on the last bag. Subset<->index bag switches no longer overflow. CUDA unchanged.

title: treelearner: reset_parameter(interaction_constraints=...) was ignored
reason: ColSampler::SetConfig now rebuilds interaction_constraints on reset; 1.1.0 (inherited) kept the constraints from construction, so a reset was silently ignored. CUDA not touched.

title: boosting: pred_contrib failed after further training ('Check failed: max_depth_ >= 0')
reason: pred_contrib after further training or a merge failed CHECK max_depth_ >= 0 (models_initialized_ cache, in 1.1.0); depths of new trees are now computed. No change for working predictions.

title: c_api: reset_parameter of an objective or metric parameter (alpha, scale_pos_weight, eval_at, ...) was ignored
reason: ResetConfig now rebuilds objective/metrics when objective or metric params (alpha, scale_pos_weight, eval_at, ...) are reset; 1.1.0 (inherited) ignored them. Native early-stop best scores also reset.

title: c_api, python: sparse pred_contrib with fewer columns than the model overflowed (CSC) / returned an invalid matrix (CSR)
reason: Sparse pred_contrib output width is now max(ncol, model features)+1; with fewer input columns, 1.1.0 CSC overflowed the heap (crash) and CSR returned a matrix whose indices exceeded its shape.

title: boosting: interaction_constraints index outside the features overflowed; clear errors for per-feature parameter sizes
reason: interaction_constraints with an index outside the features overflowed in ColSampler (abort/segfault); now a clean error at Init/reset. monotone_constraints/feature_contri size CHECK calls get messages.

title: boosting: FLC_BoosterMerge of a model with more features overflowed; other trees-per-iteration silently mispredicted
reason: GBDT::MergeFrom now refuses a model with a different num_tree_per_iteration (1.1.0 merged silently and mispredicted) or more features (1.1.0 heap overflow on predict).

title: c_api: training calls on a Booster loaded from a model crashed (null train data / config)
reason: Training calls, add_valid, reset_training_data and training-score reads on a model-loaded Booster dereferenced null train data/config (segfault); now a clean 'no training data' error.

title: python: free_dataset() left the training booster pointing at freed Datasets (use-after-free on reset/add_valid)
reason: Booster.free_dataset() now detaches the native booster by reloading its model string, so later reset/add_valid no longer read freed Datasets (UAF); model and predictions unchanged.

title: treelearner: monotone constraints were violated with path_smooth (violation sentinel gain 0 passed a negative min_gain_shift)
reason: Monotone-violation sentinel gain is now -inf on CPU and CUDA; with path_smooth min_gain_shift can be negative, so 1.1.0's sentinel 0 let order-breaking splits through. Not named in notes.

title: boosting/treelearner: resets broke DART (every tree dropped) and changed later trees (feature_fraction / extra_trees streams)
reason: DART reset no longer zeroes sum_weight_ (1.1.0 dropped every tree after any reset); resets no longer advance the feature_fraction stream or reseed extra_trees streams. No-reset training identical.

title: cuda: rf with feature_fraction crashed when the train score was read (forest OOB pass used another tree's packed view)
reason: CUDA rf forest_batched OOB scoring used another tree's packed column view under feature_fraction<1 (illegal memory access when train score is read); restores the original view (code in 1.1.0).

title: c_api: changing the training Dataset's group/weight after Booster creation (heap-use-after-free / ignored)
reason: Booster now rebuilds objective/metrics when the train/valid Dataset's fields change after creation; 1.1.0 ignored added/cleared weights, used stale Init state, and UAF'd on new groups.

title: docs: explain by-design code that reads like a bug
reason: Adds 45 explanatory comments in 40 files; every changed line is a comment (described as identical after comment stripping / unchanged AST).

title: python: pred_leaf overflowed its buffer when the Booster trained during the prediction
reason: Python pred_leaf sizes its buffer from a range resolved once, and C API save/dump/importance/iteration reads take the shared lock; concurrent training overflowed/UAF'd. Same output without concurrency.

title: io: Atof read a >308-digit fraction as NaN and wrapped long exponents
reason: Common::Atof (1.1.0 code) read literals with >308 fraction digits as NaN (missing) and wrapped exponents >~4e9 (1e4294967296 -> 1); now finite/saturated. Bins, models, file predictions change.

title: arrow: validate each chunk against its schema before reading it
reason: ArrowChunkedArray now validates each chunk (pointers, length/offset, buffers, children) via nanoarrow before reading; malformed C Data Interface arrays were read out of bounds or through NULL.

title: c_api: reject an Arrow dataset with more columns than its reference (heap overflow)
reason: Arrow Dataset with a reference now requires the same column count; more columns overflowed the heap in PushOneValue. Fewer columns via raw C API is also now refused (Python already refused it).

title: io: FindBin with more sampled values than sampled rows (duplicate feature in a row)
reason: FindBin now sets total_sample_cnt = num_sample_values (with a warning) when a sampled row lists a feature twice; 1.1.0 got a negative zero count, so bin boundaries for that feature change.

title: arrow: read a sliced struct's fields at the parent's offset and length (heap overflow)
reason: Arrow View::field re-bases struct children onto the parent's offset/length (1.1.0 code read children whole): Dataset creation overflowed (crash), predict/init_score from a sliced struct read wrong rows.

title: boosting: GOSS and bagging keep their row sample stream across a parameter reset
reason: ResetBaggingRands keeps GOSS/bagging row-sample streams across resets unless bagging_seed/row count changes; 1.1.0 GOSS restarted its stream on every reset and bagging ignored bagging_seed resets.

title: treelearner: no memcpy through a null pointer when a split has no category thresholds
reason: SplitInfo CopyTo/CopyFrom skip a zero-length memcpy through a null data() pointer (UBSan-only report); serialized bytes and parallel-learner behaviour unchanged.

title: io: TextReader skips every blank line, not only those inside a chunk
reason: TextReader now skips all leading line breaks of a chunk; 1.1.0 turned a blank line at file start (or a CRLF straddling the 16 MiB chunk boundary) into an extra all-zero row with label 0.

title: io: a trivial feature's bin mapper serializes a valid most_freq_bin (data-parallel training failed)
reason: Initializes BinMapper scalars (most_freq_bin_ etc.) so trivial mappers serialize valid values; failure is a regression from #462's CopyFrom range checks (garbage was unused in 1.1.0).

title: tests: test_register_custom_logger sets verbose=1 instead of inheriting the log level
reason: Test-only: test_register_custom_logger passes verbose=1 explicitly; library behaviour unchanged.

title: io: range-check categorical values before the int cast in FindBin
reason: Categorical FindBin cast values >=2^31/+inf to int (UB). x86 gave INT_MIN (NaN bin, unchanged); saturating CPUs kept category INT_MAX, which ValueToBin never returns. Now NaN bin.

title: c_api: reject Arrow inputs of more than INT32_MAX rows instead of truncating the count
reason: Arrow Dataset creation and prediction cast an int64 row count to int; >INT32_MAX rows silently dropped rows (2^32+100 -> 100). Now rejected via CheckedRowCount; code was in 1.1.0.

title: docs: set_leaf_output / FLC_BoosterSetLeafValue do not update the cached train/valid scores
reason: Docs plus a test pinning the existing behaviour: set_leaf_output does not update cached train/valid scores; no code change.

title: io: binary dataset header must start its group bin boundaries at 0
reason: A corrupt binary dataset header with shifted group_bin_boundaries overflowed the col-wise histogram buffer; now refused at load. Valid save_binary files unaffected.

title: io: a failed native file write raised nothing (full disk left a truncated file)
reason: Failed native file writes (full disk) now raise instead of leaving a truncated file (save_binary, save_model, snapshots, CLI predict output); models/predictions unchanged.

title: io: distributed bin finding uses each feature's own forced bins and max_bin
reason: Distributed bin finding indexed forced_bin_bounds (and text-file max_bin_by_feature) with the local index, so ranks >0 used other features' bins; inherited code present in 1.1.0.

title: network: validate the machine list's rank= entry (heap overflow on rank= / negative rank)
reason: rank= / negative rank in the machine list overflowed the heap; now validated. Junk like rank=abc / rank=1x (silently 0 / 1 before) is also now an error.

title: boosting: refit rebuilds the first trees from the average score (log-link refits were NaN)
reason: Refit started from score 0 and gave the first (bias-carrying) trees an unshrunk Newton step; now starts from the average and rebuilds them as training did. NaN for poisson/tweedie, worse for all.

title: treelearner: a huge max_cat_threshold overflowed the parallel split sync buffer (segfault)
reason: Parallel learners sized the split-sync buffer from an int-overflowing SplitInfo::Size(max_cat_threshold); huge values segfaulted. Now sized from the bins; same model for normal values.

title: network: an unreachable higher-ranked peer is an error, not a NULL linker (null deref)
reason: An unreachable higher-ranked peer left a NULL linker and segfaulted on the first collective; now a clean error.

title: io: GreedyFindBin returns the single bin when asked for one
reason: GreedyFindBin with max_bin==1 wrote past lower_bounds and returned two bounds, failing CHECK_GT(max_bin,0) (forced bins + unfiltered C API samples); now returns one bin.

title: network: no memcpy from a NULL buffer for an empty Allgather block (UBSan)
reason: Skips memcpy of an empty block from a NULL buffer (UB only flagged by UBSan); plain builds unchanged.

title: io: refuse a loaded tree node whose decision_type has missing type 3
reason: A loaded tree node with missing type 3 (never written by Falcata) loaded and predicted as None while dump said NaN; now refused at load.

title: io: precise_float_parser reads missing values and spacing like the default parser
reason: precise_float_parser=true failed on empty fields, NA/null/-, and spaces before a delimiter; now reads them like the default parser. Numeric values parsed as before.

title: c_api: pushes into a finished Dataset and training on an unfinished one are errors (silent row loss, segfault)
reason: Rows pushed after a Dataset auto-finished (or into a constructed Dataset) were silently dropped; now an error. Training on an unfinished Dataset (segfault) is also now an error.

title: io: numerical bins split +inf and overflowing midpoints from their neighbours
reason: GreedyFindBin bin bound (a+b)/2 overflowed for b=+inf or huge |a+b|, merging the values into one bin; now finite bound. Bit-identical otherwise (Z3).

title: sparse: unsorted CSC rows and duplicate entries were trained on / predicted for as a different matrix
reason: CSC with unsorted row indices read entries as 0, and duplicate entries were taken once (scipy sums them); Python now canonicalises; C API rejects unsorted/duplicate CSC rows.

title: io: an empty last CSV/TSV field is a missing value, not zero
reason: CSV/TSV parser never visited the empty field after a line's final delimiter, so it read as 0; now NaN like an empty middle field. Code present in 1.1.0.

title: treelearner: update(train_set=...) lays the cached histograms out for the new Dataset (heap overflow)
reason: update(train_set=new) kept histogram pool buffers/offsets of the old layout: growth overflowed the heap, other layout changes read misplaced bins silently. Now relaid out.

title: utils: a data token with % signs crashed the loader (exception text used as a printf format)
reason: Exception text quoting a data token was used as a printf format in OMP_LOOP_EX_END; % signs segfaulted. Now passed through %s.

title: io: CSV/TSV sniffers count empty fields
reason: Sniffers miscounted empty fields: TSV with empty first/last field refused; predict file with a missing value on line 1 taken to have a label (refused, or shifted silently with predict_disable_shape_check).

title: treelearner: data/voting-parallel with interaction_constraints read branch features at leaf -1 (heap overflow)
reason: Data/voting-parallel called GetByNode for leaf -1 at the root: crash with interaction_constraints, and without them an extra feature_fraction_bynode RNG draw per tree that is now gone.

title: io: walk trees iteratively in the JSON dump, the if-else export and the depth pass
reason: Recursive JSON dump, if-else export and leaf-depth pass overflowed the stack on ~10k-deep trees; now iterative with byte-identical output.

title: c_api: pushes stay within the sparse bins' per-thread push buffers (heap overflow)
reason: Push APIs indexed sparse-bin per-thread push buffers past their size (thread count rose, unchecked tid, bad InitStreaming counts): heap overflow; now sized/validated. Data unchanged.

title: c_api: sparse pred_contrib with zero rows on a multiclass model read index -1 (segfault)
reason: Sparse pred_contrib with zero rows on a multiclass model read index -1 and segfaulted; empty class matrices now size 0.

title: config: build the auc_mu weight matrix only for the auc_mu metric (num_class^2 memory on every Config::Set)
reason: Config::Set built a num_class^2 auc_mu weight matrix every time (bad_alloc for huge num_class); now built only by AucMuMetric with the same default values.

title: treelearner, boosting: no signed overflow from INT_MAX seeds or min_data_in_leaf (UBSan)
reason: Signed-overflow UB for INT_MAX min_data_in_leaf / extra_seed: 64-bit compare and uint32 seed add; non-overflowing values unchanged, overflow wraps as x86 did.

title: io: read the bin mappers gathered from other machines within the gathered buffer (heap overflow)
reason: Gathered bin mappers from peers were read unsized; a corrupt or truncated block overflowed the buffer. Now read with the bounded CopyFrom; well-formed buffers read as before.

title: application: objective=custom on the command line is an error, not a null dereference
reason: CLI objective=custom (none/null/na) dereferenced a null objective in task=train/refit; now a clear error.

title: python: a native error quoting non-UTF-8 text raised UnicodeDecodeError, not FalcataError
reason: Native error text decoded with errors='replace' so non-UTF-8 messages raise FalcataError instead of UnicodeDecodeError; exception type/text only.

title: treelearner: parallel learners check that num_leaves / max_depth / max_cat_threshold / top_k agree across machines (SEGV)
reason: Data/voting-parallel now allreduce-check that tree_learner, num_leaves, max_depth, max_cat_threshold, top_k, feature_fraction*, its seed and min_data_in_leaf agree; mismatches mostly crashed.

title: config: numeric parameters accepted junk tokens ("1,x" meant "1,0"; max_depth="-" meant 0)
reason: List-valued numeric params parsed by Atoi/stod accepted junk ('1,x' -> 1,0; '20x' -> 20); now rejected. Subnormal leaf_coeff in model text now loads.

title: treelearner: data/voting-parallel use the exact global child counts, as serial training does (multiclass drifted from serial)
reason: Data/voting-parallel kept hessian-inferred global child counts (exact only for constant hessian) for min_data_in_leaf checks and leaf_count; now uses summed partition counts as serial does.

title: treelearner: voting-parallel root output from the global sums (workers' rf models differed)
reason: Voting-parallel set a split-less tree's root output from local sums, and both parallel learners used the local row count for path smoothing; now global. Visible in rf root-only trees.

title: python: a Sequence's batches must cover its rows (negative batch_size / short batches trained on unfilled rows)
reason: Sequence with negative batch_size pushed nothing, short batches left rows unpushed, and the Dataset trained on unfilled rows silently; now ValueError. List batches now accepted.

title: hardening: GOSS warm-up cast overflow, SWIG error-path leak, duration passed to %f
reason: GOSS warm-up cast 1/learning_rate to int (UB, INT_MIN on x86 for lr < ~4.7e-10) so it sampled from iteration 0; now compared in double. Normal lr bit-identical; rest hardening.

title: treelearner: a config without CEGB drops the CEGB state (rejected reset_parameter overflowed its cache)
reason: A rejected reset_parameter left a stale CEGB object sized for the rejected config; training overflowed it. Now dropped when CEGB is off; zero-penalty stale state gave delta 0, so no model change.

title: treelearner: monotone_constraints_method=advanced with a categorical feature and no monotone constraint segfaulted
reason: monotone_constraints_method=advanced without any monotone constraint segfaulted on categorical splits; now passes an unconstrained BasicConstraint when USE_MC is false (ignored there anyway).

title: config: reject malformed interaction_constraints (silently fewer constraints; model then fails to load in Python)
reason: Malformed interaction_constraints ('x', unbalanced or trailing junk) were read as fewer/no constraints and then broke Python model loading; now a syntax error.

title: boosting, io: malformed forced-splits / forced-bins files forced feature 0 or were silently dropped
reason: json11 read missing/non-numeric forced-split and forced-bin fields as 0: forced feature 0, dropped splits, put bounds on feature 0. Now type-checked with errors.

title: io: metadata pushed with the rows is sanitised like metadata set as a field (NaN labels changed the model)
reason: Metadata pushed with rows (InsertLabels/Weights/InitScores) was memcpy'd without AvoidInf, so NaN/inf labels, weights or init scores stayed; now sanitised like set_field.

title: io: a missing forced-bins or parser-config file was silently ignored
reason: A missing forcedbins_filename only warned (hidden at verbose<0) and a missing parser_config_file read as empty (default parser); both are now errors.

title: io: label_column one past the last column read every label as 0; clear errors for bad inputs
reason: label_column exactly one past the last CSV/TSV column passed the range check and read every label as 0; now rejected. Other CHECK failures get clear messages.

title: objective: regression and cross-entropy boost from the global average label in distributed training
reason: boost_from_average took the mean of machines' local averages; regression-family and cross-entropy BoostFromScore now sum label/weight totals globally as binary does.

title: io: an out-of-range categorical_feature / ignore_column index was silently ignored
reason: Out-of-range categorical_feature / ignore_column indices were stored and never matched a column (silently ignored); now an error once the feature count is known.

title: config: monotone_constraints accepted values other than -1/0/1 (2 broke monotonicity)
reason: monotone_constraints_method is now lowercased, so 'Intermediate'/'ADVANCED' (silently basic in 1.1.0) take effect; unknown methods and constraint values outside -1/0/1 now rejected.

title: cuda: allocate the deterministic sparse tile partials only when the sparse float construct can run (#534)
reason: CUDA deterministic sparse tile partials are allocated only when the sparse float construct can run; allocation gate only, models measured identical.

title: io: feature names with a newline (or empty) broke the saved model; validate_features rejected the training frame
reason: Feature names with newline split the model's feature_names line (model unloadable; flc.train failed); now mapped to '_', empty names refused; validate_features maps names like storage.

title: treelearner: data-parallel skips the features the parent could not split on, as serial training does (regularized models drifted)
reason: Data-parallel evaluated features in children that the parent could not split on, which serial prunes; with regularization a child took splits serial never considers. Now pruned.

title: boosting: a model with a backslash in a string parameter could not be loaded in Python
reason: GetLoadedParam wrote string params into JSON unescaped (backslash made Python model load fail) and split at every ':' (values cut in Booster.params); now escaped, split once.

title: config: num_threads=100000 segfaulted the process (libgomp stack overflow)
reason: Config now fatals on num_threads > max(1024, 4 x hardware threads); 100000 segfaulted (libgomp stack), but values like 2000-20000 trained in 1.1.0 and are now refused.

title: python: unsavable pandas categories gave "Circular reference detected" after training
reason: Python JSON hook now raises a clear TypeError for unsavable pandas categories (Timestamp/bytes/Decimal) instead of 'Circular reference detected'; save writes nothing on failure. 1.1.0 also raised.

title: cuda: a reset that turns bagging off makes the CUDA learner train on every row again (device use-after-free)
reason: 1.1.0 CUDA partition kept use_bagging_ after a reset turning bagging off, training on the last (freed) bag; now releases bag and trains on all rows. Was silently wrong or raised [CUDA] invalid argument.

title: cuda: reset_parameter of interaction_constraints / feature_fraction_bynode takes effect on the CUDA learner
reason: CUDA ResetConfig now recomputes select_features_by_node_; 1.1.0 decided per-node feature selection once in Init, so resets adding interaction_constraints or lowering feature_fraction_bynode were ignored.

title: cuda: clearing a training Dataset's weights after Booster creation clears the device copy
reason: Clearing weights (set_field('weight', None)) now clears the CUDA device copy; in 1.1.0 the device kept the old weights so CUDA objectives/metrics trained weighted. Completes #533's rebuild for CUDA.

title: treelearner: voting-parallel builds the local histograms of every feature it may aggregate (stale histograms summed)
reason: Voting-parallel now builds/subtracts local histograms for all sampled features, not only locally splittable ones; 1.1.0 (inherited from LightGBM) summed stale histograms for globally voted features.

title: io: a CSV header with an empty column name failed on an internal CHECK (pandas to_csv index)
reason: CSV/TSV header with an empty column name (pandas to_csv index) failed on an internal size CHECK in 1.1.0; now a clear error naming the column. Whitespace-only names are also refused (edge case).

title: metric: an unknown metric name trained with no metric at all
reason: Metric::CreateMetric now fatals on unknown names (except custom/none/na); 1.1.0 returned nullptr and silently trained with no metric for typos like 'aucc'.

title: c_api: a CSC matrix with more columns than its reference overflowed the heap; dense/CSR mismatches were accepted
reason: C API now checks input column count against the reference Dataset; dense/CSR mismatches that 1.1.0 accepted (dropping or misplacing values) now fail; CSC with extra columns overflowed the heap.

title: io: a validation file with the training columns in another order (or a different count) was read scrambled
reason: Validation text file whose header orders training feature names differently, or a CSV/TSV with a different feature-column count, now fails; 1.1.0 read it by position (scrambled metrics).

title: config: quant_bins must fit the int16 quantized hessian (cap at 32767)
reason: quant_bins cap lowered from 65534 to 32767 (int16 quantized hessian); 1.1.0 accepted 32768-65534 and CUDA constant-hessian training grew split-less trees.

title: tests: SaveBinary no-features test removes a stale output file first
reason: Test-only: SaveBinary no-features gtest removes a stale output file before saving.

title: tests: monotone_constraints_method intermediate/advanced tests pin device_type=cpu (failed under TASK=cuda)
reason: Test-only: intermediate/advanced monotone method tests pin device_type=cpu.

title: tests: the GOSS warm-up test pins quant_mode=none (CUDA GOSS quantizes at another resolution by design)
reason: Test-only: GOSS warm-up test pins quant_mode=none.

title: cuda: rescoring GBDT's own constant trees wrote the device score from the host (update(train_set=...) segfault without usable features)
reason: CUDAScoreUpdater::AddScore wrote host constant trees (GBDT's own, no usable features) through the device pointer: segfault in 1.1.0 on update(train_set=), add_valid, rollback, DART. Now device kernel/host round trip.

title: cuda: weights set or cleared after Booster creation re-resolve the quantization bins (set_field tests failed under TASK=cuda)
reason: CUDA learner now re-resolves quant bins (deterministic auto-raise 2048 vs 256, non-const clamp, robust scale) when is_constant_hessian changes; 1.1.0 kept Init's choice, e.g. after reset_parameter objective change.

title: cuda: hold the deterministic sparse tile partials within a byte budget (#534)
reason: Deterministic sparse tile partials (present in 1.1.0) now capped at 96 MB/pipeline: above ~49k total bins fewer row tiles; PR says sums may round differently in last bits (equal md5 on its data).

title: io: a binary Dataset file read as text fails with one clear error, whatever it stores
reason: Reading a save_binary Dataset file as text (predict on it, init score of a binary-file Dataset) failed with a byte-dependent error in 1.1.0; now one clear error. A rare nonsensical 'successful' parse is also refused.

title: cuda: test that trees do not depend on the card's SM count (FALCATA_DEBUG=smcount=N)
reason: Routes SM-count queries through one helper and adds a FALCATA_DEBUG=smcount=N test hook; byte-identical models without the token; test-only otherwise.

title: io: the stored-bin scan of a loaded binary dataset keeps the maximum in the bin's own width (h60 load +31% since a634f78f)
reason: Perf of DenseBin::MaxStoredBin, the loaded-bin scan added after 1.1.0 by a634f78f (bounds-check binary loaders); same result, bins identical.

title: tests: position tests run in CUDA builds now that only the CUDA ranking objectives refuse positions
reason: Test-only: position tests run/pin cpu in CUDA builds after #627.

title: docs: 1.2.0 release notes for #627, #628 and #629 (merge after #629)
reason: Docs-only: 1.2.0 release notes for #627-#629.

title: docs: 1.2.0 notes for #613/#626 and #624's saved binaries; README gate counts
reason: Docs-only: release notes for #613/#626 and #624, README gate counts.

title: cuda: the level split finder's L1 / path-smoothing variants in their own module (first Booster back to 1.1.0's time)
reason: Moves the level split finder's L1/smoothing kernel variants verbatim into a separate CUDA module (startup time); kernels and launches unchanged, gate fingerprints pass.

title: docs: 1.2.0 note on how much exact feature bundles (#624) move trained models
reason: Docs-only: release-note paragraph on how much #624 moves models.

title: python: predict(device=None) sends a host array to the GPU only where a cost estimate says it wins (1.2.0 predict regressions)
reason: predict(device=None) GPU routing from #618/#620 now cost-gated and in-order (CPU bits); 1.1.0 predicted on CPU, so output vs 1.1.0 unchanged. Also predict Config skips training checks/GPU probe.

title: tests: probe the CUDA predictor at run time, never while collecting (fixes the forked CUDA nightly)
reason: Test-only: CUDA predictor probe moved out of collection; new collection guard test.

title: cuda: pad the int8 tile binner's shared-memory columns (16-way bank conflict, kernel 1.25x faster)
reason: Pads the int8 tile binner's shared-memory column stride (bank conflicts); binned bytes unchanged, perf only.

title: cuda: magnitude-bucket math in float (no fp64 per gradient in ComputeGradMagHistogramKernel)
reason: Magnitude-bucket math in float instead of double; exhaustively shown identical buckets for all 2^32 inputs, model md5s identical.

title: cuda: reduce startup column uploads, unused selective thresholds, and one-shot graph builds
reason: Startup perf: batched dense column uploads (same bytes), skip unused real-threshold upload and defer graph capture on selective prefixes (1.2-line); model/pred md5s identical.

title: docs: 1.2.0 release summary, 1.2 speed section in performance.md, README for complete device trees and device=None
reason: Docs-only: 1.2.0 release summary, performance.md speed section, README.
